component.name: ServerRemote
component.summary: Remote console client for servers and virtual machines

description.p: A native remote console client for servers and virtual machines, with support for HPE iLO and Spice.

ul.li: HPE iLO 4 Remote Console: an independent implementation of the Integrated Remote Console: video, keyboard and mouse, power control and server status.
Spice: for virtual machines running in QEMU, whether managed with libvirt or by hand.

description.p: Each protocol adds its own menus, actions and status indicators, such as power control and health for iLO. Multiple connections open side by side in tabs. Saved connections show a thumbnail of their last screen, sorted into groups.

screenshot.caption: A remote Linux desktop, with connection tabs and a toolbar above it and a status bar below
